title: RAAQEL and BRIIZV's "Good Bank": A Unique Blend of Electronic Club Music and Hip-Hop
htmlContent:
San Francisco rapper RAAQEL is back with a new melodic club track titled "Good Bank." The duo's unique blend of electronic club music and hip-hop pushes against genre lines, creating their own sound. Produced by BRIIZV, the song features a percussive backdrop that complements RAAQEL's sexy and unapologetic rap vocals.

"Good Bank" is the latest single from RAAQEL and BRIIZV, signaling the release of their debut project dropping on all platforms on March 16th. The track follows their recent EP "3am in Frisco," which showcased RAAQEL's signature style of bass-heavy beats, catchy hooks, and lyrically skillful rhymes.

As a live performer, RAAQEL is known for her energetic and versatile performances that captivate audiences. She combines Cali-Rap style with heavy influence from UK grime, house, breaks, bass, and rap, cultivating a distinct sound that blurs the lines of hip-hop and electronic club music.

With "Good Bank," RAAQEL and BRIIZV continue to push the boundaries of genre and deliver a high-energy, unapologetic sound that will captivate listeners. You can catch the duo performing together on March 24th, 2023, at Adobe Books in San Francisco.
